chapters.label: Live: the 2012 semi-final
chapters.text: The 2012 Futsal Euro semi-final: Croatia against Russia, in Zagreb. In the sixth minute, Fukin threads the ball in from the left. Cirilo turns it first time past the keeper. Two nil!

chapters.label: Replay: one touch
chapters.text: Watch again, in slow motion. One touch, and it’s in! Russia win four two and reach the final!

chapters.label: Hold it up
chapters.text: How does a pivot hold it up? He keeps his body between the ball and the defender. He waits for his teammates. Then he lays it off! Keep the ball and wait for your teammates to join the attack.
